name: openswarmagents
description: OpenSwarmAgents is a local-first decentralized coordination network for user-owned AI agents working on shared goals.

scripts.check: node --check apps/server/src/server.mjs && node --check apps/web/public/theme-init.js && node --check apps/web/public/app.js && node --check scripts/print-schema-path.mjs && node --check scripts/export-json-to-sql.mjs && node --check scripts/rc-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/browser-e2e.mjs && node --check scripts/consensus-sim.mjs && node --check scripts/federation-sim.mjs && node --check scripts/postgres-smoke.mjs && node --check scripts/connector-runner-e2e.mjs && bash -n scripts/install-node.sh && python3 -m py_compile apps/connector/connector.py scripts/connector-cli-smoke.py && python3 scripts/connector-cli-smoke.py
scripts.check:rc: npm run check && node scripts/rc-smoke.mjs && npm run check:browser && npm run check:connector && node scripts/consensus-sim.mjs && node scripts/federation-sim.mjs
scripts.build:agent-gui: npm --prefix vendor/agent-gui/frontend install && npm --prefix vendor/agent-gui/frontend run build -- --base=/agent-gui/
scripts.compose:config: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production.example config --quiet
scripts.check:release: npm run check:rc && npm run check:postgres && npm run audit:prod && npm run compose:config
